name: 3D Model Anything
subtitle: Scan, save & share your rooms
description:
Capture your spaces, one room at a time. 3D Model Anything uses the camera and LiDAR on supported iPhone Pro and iPad Pro models to save room layouts, detailed meshes, reference photos and depth data.

Organize rooms into houses. Explore interactive 3D previews, inspect photo detail, keep scan history, and connect rooms by matching doorways. Share a single room, session or whole house as a ZIP through AirDrop or the iOS share sheet. No account or Mac companion app required.

Scans stay on your device unless you choose to share them. Devices without LiDAR can import extracted room or session folders, view scans and share them.

Scanning requires a LiDAR-equipped iPhone Pro or iPad Pro and iOS/iPadOS 17 or later. Scan quality depends on lighting, motion and the surfaces in your room. Measurements are approximate; verify before precision work. Photo detail measures photography on observed surfaces, not scanning completeness.

Optionally enable Record compass directions (off for every new session) to record compass observations during scanning and retain them for reconstructed wall and window direction labels. Location permission enables true north; unavailable location produces explicitly magnetic readings. Geographic coordinates are not saved. Sensor estimates can be affected by indoor magnetic interference.

privacyAnswers.note: Confirm against the final binary and any SDK additions. Exports are user-initiated through the system share sheet.

reviewNotes: No login or companion software is required. To scan, use a LiDAR-equipped iPhone Pro or iPad Pro. Tap New house, enter a name, allow Camera, then name and scan a room. Finish room and Finish session to save. Open the saved room to inspect its 3D preview and Share room. Scans are stored locally. Non-LiDAR devices support importing extracted 3D Model Anything room/session folders using the upper-left import button. Privacy policy and help are under the upper-right Help & privacy button. Scan quality and room photo-detail percentage are not claims of measurement accuracy or room completeness. Direction recording is off for every new session. Enable Record compass directions before scanning or while paused; only enabling this option requests Location While Using the App for true-north compass capture. Declining Location preserves magnetic direction recording.
